scope: Same formal 1000 scenes 0-999 at -4 and 0 dB, exactly one linear measurement message per branch. No networks, new scenes, or closed-loop inference.
grouping: Within-user ascending public Gram eigenmode indices, equal-length consecutive groups. The folded four-group sensitivity branch has index sets [0,7,8,15],[1,6,9,14],[2,5,10,13],[3,4,11,12]. These are fixed public rules, not truth or query fitted.

reference.description: Universal CN(0,I) reference after whitening by a public covariance; no oracle variance refit. Descriptive reference distribution, no per-query p-values.

success_boundaries: No detection improvement claim from raw query MSE or marginal structure.
Group-average variance can be correct while individual mode gain and diagonal variance are wrong.
All first-step queries are related by invertible public scalings; MSE comparisons do not compare information content.
Gaussian covariance algebra holds for frozen coefficients and isotropic prior error, not as an unconditional law for data-dependent noise estimation.
Keep near-singular cases and all seven branches, separate SNR/activity and prior exposure. No automatic branch adoption.
Algebra and baseline endpoint replay relative error <=1e-9; no arbitrary learned-distribution pass threshold.
